acceptanceCriteria: An existing operation.lock reports operation-in-progress without disturbing the owner.
Permission and other filesystem failures creating the lock retain distinct actionable errors, covered by deterministic regressions.
Lock acquisition/release and reviewed completion still pass their focused lifecycle tests; failures do not bypass ownership or alter enrollment.
body: Observed during 2026-09-28 bugfix closeout on independently reviewed TCP and HLQ worktrees. corvint dogfood review reported operation-in-progress while no workflow process owned a lock. internal/localcompletion/storage.go repository.lock maps every os.Mkdir(operation.lock) failure to operation-in-progress, including the sandbox denying writes under .git. Retrying the identical reviewed action with authorized filesystem access succeeded immediately; no lock was removed or workflow reset. Preserve error meaning so an operator does not mistake a permission failure for contention or attempt unsafe lock removal.
title: Report local completion lock permission failures distinctly from concurrent operations
